Results.ReviewText: Make sure you understand the "flow limiting device" before you fire this up for the first time. It took be a half hour to cook 10 burgers and I wondered why the grill wasn't getting up to temperature. I was ready to return it the next day, until I read about this feature. This is my first gas grill (I've alway owned Weber charcoal grills) so I was clueless about this safety feature. Anyway, this thing is built like a tank; is easy to use (now); and I don't have to fuss with charcoal. It's a whole new way of cooking so, if you're moving on from a charcoal grill, give it some time and be patient. It is very expensive compared with the many other gas grills on the market (I purchased it for the Weber brand) but I think worth the money. One more thing: upon the strong advice from a family member I had the E-310 assembled and delivered (it weighs 130 pounds and has many parts). Assembly and delivery was free from ACE Hardware and I probably saved 5 hours of labor and a lot of frustration. The ACE Hardware tech who assembled it said he's done "probably 50" says it still takes him 3+ hours to build one of these. One more thing: the little pictures of the grill on the 3 control knobs, while cute, are a branding item gone too far: What's wrong with arrows to show what the temperature setting is?
Results.Title: Nicely constructed and expensive

Results.ReviewText: I had purchased a new Char Broil grill but it had too many design flaws, so I worked with Lowe's, returned it and purchased the Weber Spirit E-310.  I like doing mechanical things, so I was glad it wasn't put together.  I was amazed with the quality of everything that went into the grill.  From the fasteners, to the wheels to the heat tents.  Everything is absolutely first class.  This grill solved the three design issues I had with the Char Broil.  1.  The gas tube that lights the other burners is in the back where it should be, so it doesn't burn your hands.  2.  The gas tubes and heat tents are good size so you get even heating.  and 3.  The grill itself is heavy duty and adds to the even heating.  Overall, an excellent grill that I love using.
Results.Title: Outstanding design and quality.

Results.ReviewText:
I have only had this grill for 3 weeks, but I have grilled every day!  It is a typical weber grill; typical in that it is perfect!  The manual was easy to understand, it heats evenly, the temperature gauge is accurate, it sears well, it's easy to clean and cooks meats to perfection (if you use it correctly!). 
 Some reviewers have complained of rust or other poor weathering....I haven't had it long enough to even comment on that.  However, I did decide to protect my investment with a weber grill cover (seems like a no-brainer).  I hope to have this beauty for years to come~my last one lasted 15 years and while I could have rebuilt some of the inner parts, I chose to purchase new instead.
Results.Title: Typical Weber quality

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
